collection.description: An elder sitting in the sun looks down at their own old hands, and thinks of everything they have done.

setup.name: The moment
setup.text: (subject) is sitting in the sun, and (subject.he/she) happens to look down at (subject.his/her) own hands. They're old hands now. Spotted and wrinkled, the knuckles a bit swollen, a little scar on one thumb from a knife that slipped long ago. (subject.He/She) turns them over. These hands have planted, and built, and mended, and cooked thousands of meals. They have held babies, and other hands, and once a very angry crab. They have waved goodbye and waved hello. (subject) looks at them for a long time, with a kind of surprised fondness, the way you'd look at an old friend you suddenly realize has been there the whole time. Then (child), a child, calls (subject.his/her) name, and the hands go back to work.
